description_en: After creating an Elastic Accelerated Computing Instances (EAIS) instance, you can call the AttachEaisEi API to attach the EAIS instance to a client instance (an ECS instance or an ECI instance) to provide it with GPU resources
description_zh: 创建弹性加速计算实例EAIS实例后，您需要调用API AttachEaisEi将该EAIS实例绑定到客户端实例（ECS实例或ECI实例）上，才能为客户端实例提供GPU资源
kebab_example: aliyun eais attach-eais-ei --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-instance-id i-bp14ws9hbt1oe0u90000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachEaisEi

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS or ECI instance to attach
parameters.name: client_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The EAIS instance ID. If this parameter is not set, the system automatically queries for attachable instances under your account that meet the conditions and selects the first queried instance for attachment
parameters.help_zh: EAIS实例ID。不设置该参数时，会自动查询用户账号下符合条件的可绑定实例，并选择查询出的第一个实例进行绑定
parameters.name: ei_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The specifications of the EAIS instance. When the `EiInstanceId` parameter is not specified, set this parameter to limit the specifications of the attached EAIS instance. If the `EiInstanceId` parameter is specified, this parameter does not take effect. Valid values:

eais.ei-a6.4xlarge

eais.ei-a6.2xlarge

eais.ei-a6.xlarge

eais.ei-a6.large
parameters.help_zh:
EAIS实例的规格。当未指定`EiInstanceId`参数时，可以设置该参数来限制绑定的EAIS实例规格；指定了`EiInstanceId`参数时，该参数不生效。取值范围：

eais.ei-a6.4xlarge
eais.ei-a6.2xlarge
eais.ei-a6.xlarge
eais.ei-a6.large
parameters.name: ei_instance_type

ClientInstanceId.description_en: The ECS or ECI instance ID
